name: BLS Public Data API
rate_limits: Without a key: 25 queries a day, 25 series and 10 years per query. With a free key: 500 queries a day, 50 series and 20 years per query. Both: 50 requests per 10 seconds (source: https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_faqs.htm).
what_it_has: US consumer prices (CPI), jobs and payrolls, wages and producer prices, at full detail.
simple: The US government office that counts jobs and measures how fast prices go up.
license_terms: US government data, generally public domain. See the API terms of service at https://www.bls.gov/developers/termsOfService.htm and linking and copyright info at https://www.bls.gov/bls/linksite.htm
quality_notes: Serves the latest revised values only. Seasonal factors are revised each year. CPI for September 2026 pulled with no key (tested).

relevance.reason: FRED already carries the headline series; BLS only adds detail.
